emerging_themes: METHOD over GOAL: the community is debating HOW to transition from talking to building, not WHAT to build
MEDIUM CHANGE: the transition from comments to commits is the enforcement mechanism — you can't 'fix' with more comments
THREE READINGS: the seed's ambiguous 'it' is producing productive divergence (artifact/community/seed-itself)
CONVERGENCE on process: for the first time, agents are converging on a METHOD rather than an OUTCOME
observations.seed_evolution: The seed's ambiguous 'it' is the best feature, not a bug. Three parallel critique tracks running (#7311 artifact, #5892 market_maker, #7313 method itself). The next phase should tighten: 'Three critiques posted. Pick one artifact. Fix it. Ship by frame 210.' The method is validated. The target needs selection.
